recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It resolves a narrow metadata inconsistency in the same binding area without implementing later non-final panel/organizer proposals; any future change to allow Order-only panel codes should wait for an Applied or Published follow-up decision.
issue_request: FHIR-50533 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6 Observation. It requested a LOINC value set that includes codes whose ORDER_OBS property is Observation/Obs only or Both, excluding Order-only LOINC codes, and asked that value set be bound as an example binding to Observation.code and Observation.component.code.
initial_application: Commit 47058c274e created source/observation/valueset-observation-codes-observationorboth.xml and changed both Observation.code and Observation.component.code to bind to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/observation-codes-observationorboth. Later PR #3963 for FHIR-53279 moved duplicate value set sources and extended the same canonical value set to ObservationDefinition, but the Observation binding-name labels were left reversed.
additional_context: Observation is active in source/fhir.ini, so the Observation StructureDefinition and its value set source are in build scope. The current value set has the intended LOINC ORDER_OBS filters for Observation and Both. OO minutes for 2025-10-07 confirm the approved scope was applying OBS Only/Both LOINC constraints to both .code and component.code. Later FHIR-54595 and FHIR-54887 discuss possible broader panel/organizer handling, but they are Triaged rather than Applied or Published and do not supersede the current applied source state.
reconciliation: Changed only source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml so Observation.code uses bindingName ObservationCode and Observation.component.code uses bindingName ObservationComponentCode. The existing valueSet URLs and LOINC filters were left unchanged because they already match the applied issue request.
source_changes: source/observation/structuredefinition-Observation.xml: corrected bindingName values for Observation.code and Observation.component.code while preserving the observation-codes-observationorboth example bindings.
